    Common Pending
    Pending work control center Use this page to start from your pending work, check overdue/escalated items, open the owner page, complete the source entry, then return here to verify closure.
    Process View
    Step 1Find PendingCheck My Pending, Department Pending, Approval Pending, and Overdue cards.
    Step 2Open SourceUse the related button to open PR, approval, project, service, communication, or KPI source page.
    Step 3Update EntryComplete the missing data, approval, status, owner, target date, or closure remarks in the source page.
    Step 4Verify ClosureReturn to Common Pending and refresh. The pending count should reduce or move to the next responsible owner.
    Reports & Analytics
    Report navigation control Use this page to choose the report area, open the correct source dashboard/register, check filters, export if required, and verify the report source data is updated.
    Reports Flow
    Step 1Select Report AreaChoose Project, Purchase, Store, Service, QC, Finance, HR, Customer, or Profit/Loss report.
    Step 2Check Source DataIf the report is empty, update source entries first: PR, GRN, DC, invoice, service, QC, project, or HR.
    Step 3Apply FiltersUse company, financial year, customer, project, department, and status filters in the source report page.
    Step 4Export / ReviewAfter data is correct, export Excel/PDF or use dashboard cards for management review.
    Approval Dashboard
    Approval decision control Use this page to view pending approvals, open the source transaction, verify evidence, record approve/reject/hold decision, then confirm the item leaves the pending queue.
    Approval Flow
    Step 1Pick Pending ItemOpen one approval row and read module, amount/value, requested by, due date, and remarks.
    Step 2Open SourceCheck the original PR, PO, payment, vendor, QC, expense, or HR record before decision.
    Step 3Record DecisionApprove, reject, or hold with clear remarks. Do not approve without source proof.
    Step 4Verify StatusRefresh Approval Dashboard and Common Pending. The item should close or move to next approver.

    Backup / Restore
    Backup controlCurrent offline ERP saves automatic browser backups in IndexedDB and allows manual full JSON export/import. For Google Drive, export the full backup file and upload it to the agreed Drive folder. Fully automatic Drive upload requires server/cloud integration or Google API authentication.
    Manual Google Drive Sync
    Google Drive handover steps1. Click Export Full Backup. 2. Upload the downloaded JSON file to Google Drive. 3. Keep folder name like SESS_NexaERP_Backup / Year / Month. 4. Check Backup Verification Log and Audit Trail after export/import.

    One owner, separate approver, separate view accessEvery controlled ERP document must keep Created By, Verified By, Approved By, attachment, view roles, and audit trail. Ownership is not the same as approval or visibility.

    3Control layers: owner / approve / view
    100%Audit trail required
    0Duplicate authority allowed

    Control PointERP RuleMandatory Data

    View Access RolesOnly relevant roles should view sensitive records; customers/vendors see only their own data.Role list / portal list
    AttachmentPO, GRN, drawing, invoice, service report, certificate, and ISO documents must have file proof where applicable.PDF / image / drawing reference

    Purchase Request
    Single PR entry with linked ERP context Project, complaint, machine serial, customer PO, engineer, stock, item master, attachment, approval, and GRN reminder data stay in one controlled purchase request flow.

    Sales Invoice Ledger - Customer Receivable

    Sales invoices are bills raised to customers. Only Sales Spare invoices and extra Machine invoice stock items can deduct inventory.
    Purchase Invoice Ledger - Supplier Payable

    Purchase invoices are supplier bills payable by SESS. Purchase invoices do not deduct sales inventory. Stock comes from GRN accepted quantity only.
